Strings.webservers.subtitle: Discover and manage host web servers
Strings.webservers.login_required: Sign in to a RemoteOS Server to manage its web servers.
Strings.webservers.status.unavailable: Runtime status is unavailable for this web server.
Strings.webservers.permission.read_required: Web server access requires the Read web server configuration permission.
Strings.webservers.permission.manage_required: Changing web servers requires the Manage web server configuration permission.
Strings.webservers.discover.empty: Discovery complete — no web servers found.
Strings.webservers.test.unavailable: Configuration test is unavailable for this web server.
Strings.webservers.problem.install_elevation_req: Installation requires RemoteOS Server to run with administrator privileges. Ask the server administrator to adjust the service permissions and try again.
Strings.webservers.problem.config_elevation_requ: This configuration action requires RemoteOS Server to run with administrator privileges.
Strings.webservers.problem.lifecycle_elevation_r: This service action requires RemoteOS Server to run with administrator privileges.
Strings.webservers.problem.install_not_configure: The server administrator has not configured an Nginx installer.
Strings.webservers.managed.install.title: Install managed Nginx
Strings.webservers.managed.install.message: This runs the Nginx installer preconfigured by the server administrator and installs only into the RemoteOS-owned directory. Continue?
Strings.webservers.managed.uninstall.title: Uninstall managed Nginx
Strings.webservers.managed.uninstall.message: This stops and deletes only the Nginx installation directory marked as owned by RemoteOS. This cannot be undone. Continue?
Strings.webservers.integration.confirmation.mess: This creates a RemoteOS-owned remoteos.conf in Nginx's already-included conf.d directory, tests the configuration, and only then reloads Nginx. Existing site configuration is not changed. Continue?
